summary_en: Interim dividend raised to 45 yen per share from 40 yen, and year-end dividend raised to 45 yen from 40 yen, for total of 90 yen (previous guidance: 80 yen). Full-year net profit forecast increased 20.0% to 12.0 billion yen on strong overseas subsidiary performance and cost management.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Full-Year Consolidated Earnings Forecast and Modification of Interim and Year-End Dividend Forecasts (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
Metawater raised its interim dividend for fiscal year ending March 31, 2027 by 5.00 yen to 45.00 yen per share, with record date September 30, 2026, and effective date December 2, 2026. The interim dividend increased from 40.00 yen announced on April 24, 2026. The company also revised its year-end dividend forecast upward by 5.00 yen to 45.00 yen, lifting total dividend guidance from 80.00 yen to 90.00 yen per share. This compares to 70.00 yen total in the prior fiscal year (35.00 yen interim and 35.00 yen year-end).

The company simultaneously revised its full-year consolidated net profit forecast upward by 2.0 billion yen, or 20.0%, to 12.0 billion yen. Sales guidance increased 2.1% to 245.0 billion yen, operating profit rose 16.7% to 17.5 billion yen, and ordinary profit increased 19.3% to 17.3 billion yen. Per-share earnings guidance jumped 19.9% to 274.69 yen.

The dividend increase reflects strong performance of overseas subsidiaries and rigorous project management and cost reduction measures. The company maintains a basic policy of securing necessary internal reserves while pursuing progressive dividends targeting a consolidated dividend payout ratio of 30–40%, and increased distributions to shareholders based on improved earnings prospects and current financial condition.
